properties.description: GitHub issue #617 (Alex, alexsligar-pnnl), taken up on Anthony's word on 2026-10-01 ("Let's continue on with #617"), reflow2 PR #646. The release publishes the container image as ONE multi-platform index for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, each architecture built and smoke-tested on its own native runner before anything is pushed, and the release notes name the index digest so a consumer can pin it immutably. The image's own documentation stops saying reflow2 has no authentication, which v0.76.0 made false. Must not include: cross-compiling RocksDB, QEMU, or any change to what the binary does.
properties.name: The image is one linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 index, and the release names its digest (#617)
